snippet.title: SHADE Protocol Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Fight through a dying cyber-fantasy world as Zura, a prototype capable of rewriting reality itself. Precision combat, fluid movement, and branching exploration drive this ambitious Metroidvania adventure.

Developed and published by Little Legendary.
